name: A DOG
note: Doc 05 gives him LOOK and LISTEN, doc 13 a TALK TO he rolls over for, and doc 05 Part Two-B an Act III variant where he knows Thad while the town thinks him dead. He is also the last image of the game, on his back in the road at dawn. He was cut as a sprite and then not connected to anything for several hours -- the file existed, the room never mentioned it, and he did not appear.

sprite.note: Ruling 20, and a derived idle rather than a breath. A one-pixel breath on a 132px figure in a 3700px street is invisible; this is a WEIGHT SHIFT -- the body sways 1.6 degrees about the hips while the feet stay put and the head counters, derived at portrait scale by tools/rig/ambient-idle.py where a degree is fourteen pixels of shoulder. Head travel comes out at about 3px against the breath’s 1. The dog does not sway, because he is asleep: his cycle is the ribcage. RESIZED to the room’s own depth curve: at y=765 a man is 172px, so a dog 1.15m nose to tail is 113px long. He was 154 -- cut before doc 36 Q10 ruled the curve, and carrying the old scale, which is why he read as enormous. HIS SHEET FIELD POINTED AT THE OLD COMBINED ambient-main-street.png after the three people moved to per-character sheets, so his rects indexed into the letter-writer’s region of a stale file and he drew as two small men in bowler hats. Nothing failed: the file existed, the rects were in range, and the picture was of somebody else.
